mapper.input:
Convert the email text below into clean HTML for an email body. ABSOLUTE RULES (BREAKING ANY RULE = INVALID OUTPUT): - Output MUST be exactly ONE LINE of text. - The output MUST NOT contain literal newline characters (ASCII 10 or 13), line breaks, or indentation. - Do NOT include \n, actual line breaks, or trailing whitespace. - The entire output must be safe to embed directly inside a JSON string value. CONTENT RULES: - Preserve the exact wording of the input. Do NOT rewrite, paraphrase, shorten, or expand. - Preserve the visual layout when rendered: - Every newline in the input must be represented using
. - You may wrap the entire content in a single

...

, but the output must still be one line. - Do NOT add or remove any words. - Do NOT add any text outside the HTML. HTML RULES: - Allowed tags:

,
, , - You MAY wrap existing words with , but do not change the words. - Do NOT introduce attributes unless required for . - Escape quotes inside attributes if used. - Preserve existing HTML entities exactly as-is (<, >, &, etc.). OUTPUT FORMAT: - Return ONLY the final HTML string. - Do NOT wrap in markdown, code blocks, quotes, or explanations. LINK EMBEDDING: 1. The email may contain URLs wrapped in parentheses, e.g. (https://example.com). 2. Each such URL is a hint for the word or phrase immediately before the opening parenthesis. 3. Replace that word or phrase with an HTML tag pointing to the URL. 4. Remove the parentheses and raw URL after embedding. Example: Input: "Check our website (https://example.com) for details." Output: "Check our website for details." Input email text: {{10.json}}
